verdict.rationale: Termius docs explicitly describe grouping hosts (Groups with shared jump host config) and broadcasting a single command to all sessions simultaneously, including saving the setup as a reusable template, plus running snippets on multiple hosts at once. This directly matches the power-user story of grouping sessions and broadcasting commands. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration specifically of the broadcast feature (community evidence covers other aspects like snippets/monitoring but not explicit multi-session broadcast confirmation).
